changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Glossary_Fields] AS select O.ID as AssetID, O.ObjectID, O.TypeID as ArtifactTypeID, O.DisplayValue, F.FieldTypeID, F.Name as FieldName, F.FriendlyName as FieldFriendlyName, F.FormattedValue as FieldValue from AssetDetail O inner join FieldDetail F on F.AssetID = O.ID where O.AssetTypeClass = 1
